en: A black-and-white image showing a hilly landscape dotted with trees and residential buildings. The scene includes detached houses with steeply pitched roofs, some multi-story villas, and larger buildings on the hilltop. The architecture is characteristic of Central European towns from the late 19th to early 20th century. The foreground is dominated by orchards or gardens, with no visible text or signage.
